steps.content: Accompanied by echoes tinkling like wind chimes, luminous plankton emerge one by one, resembling stars strewn across the darkness, drawing closer to you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pylgia... Is that you?

Memories of her flood back to you—from the dream you had when you first came, to the initial distance between you at your first encounter, then to the trust and mutual reliance you forged while fighting alongside each other.

She is your companion, and what Schorl referred to as your "safety net" in the dream. Regardless of the perils you encounter, she would always find and save you. Perhaps this is the memory etched into your very soul, as well as an inexorable fate intertwining you and them.
You reach out towards the luminous being, but upon the touch, a vision flashes through your mind—Pylgia's face, contorted and marred by the taint of the Abyss.
The truth hits you again: This fate brings not only meetings but partings too—unbearably painful partings. You refuse to accept this imminent parting, your body instinctively recoiling.
As you flinch, the luminous beings that were approaching you freeze in their tracks. Time creeps by, and then a voice reaches your ears.
You are... scared... Did I frighten you?
Because I am... a monster...
That voice bears deep sorrow and loneliness, echoing hollowly with an inhuman resonance that breaks your heart.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No... I'm not scared of you. No matter what you've become, you're always part of the expedition, a cherished companion.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My duty is to meet you all, to bring back lost hope and possibility. Every encounter... has been meaningful, and they are all memories I hold dear.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's just... I just...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm afraid of losing you again... just like how I lost them...
...I'm not leaving. I'm still here.
Though her voice still carries a hint of hesitation, the white beings no longer waver, approaching you once again.
Follow me. I'll take you back to where you belong.
Trust me one more time.
More white creatures emerge beside you, gliding through the water, showing you the way.
You no longer reject her kindness. Following the guidance of the luminous beings, you swim towards the surface.
